```yaml
name: Docker Browser Build & Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [master, beta, release]
    paths:
      - Dockerfile.browser
      - .dockerignore
      - tsconfig.json
      - events/**
      - src/**
      - package.json
      - yarn.lock
      - .github/workflows/docker-browser.yml
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 1,15 * *'  # 02:00 UTC on the 1st and 15th
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      digest: ${{ steps.digest.outputs.DIGEST }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: Dockerfile.browser
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64,linux/arm/v7
          push: true
          tags: ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer:browser-${{ github.sha }}
          labels: |
            org.opencontainers.image.source=${{ github.repositoryUrl }}
            org.opencontainers.image.revision=${{ github.sha }}
            org.opencontainers.image.version=${{ github.ref_name }}
          cache-from: type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer:browser-cache
          cache-to: type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer:browser-cache,mode=max
          provenance: true
          sbom: true

      - name: Get image digest
        id: digest
        run: |
          DIGEST=$(docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer:browser-${{ github.sha }})
          echo "DIGEST=$DIGEST" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Report image size
        run: |
          SIZE=$(docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer:browser-${{ github.sha }} | grep -i 'size' | awk '{print $2}' | sed 's/,//')
          echo "Image size: $SIZE" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

  test:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      mosquitto:
        image: eclipse-mosquitto:2.0
        ports:
          - 1883:1883
    env:
      MQTT_BROKER_HOST: localhost
      MQTT_BROKER_PORT: 1883
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Pull built image
        run: |
          docker pull ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer:browser-${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Run container
        id: run
        run: |
          docker run -d --name mqtt-explorer-browser \
            -e MQTT_BROKER_HOST=$MQTT_BROKER_HOST \
            -e MQTT_BROKER_PORT=$MQTT_BROKER_PORT \
            -p 8080:80 \
            ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer:browser-${{ github.sha }}
          # Wait for health check
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:8080/health | grep -q 'ok'; then
              echo "Container healthy"
              break
            fi
            sleep 2
          done

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run browser UI tests
        env:
          BASE_URL: http://localhost:8080
          MQTT_BROKER_HOST: ${{ env.MQTT_BROKER_HOST }}
          MQTT_BROKER_PORT: ${{ env.MQTT_BROKER_PORT }}
        run: npm run test:browser

      - name: Stop container
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker stop mqtt-explorer-browser
          docker rm mqtt-explorer-browser

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          files: junit.xml
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  scan:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Scan image for vulnerabilities
        uses: anchore/scan-action@v1
        with:
          image-reference: ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer:browser-${{ github.sha }}
          severity-cutoff: HIGH
          fail-build: true
          output-format: sarif
          output-file: anchore.sarif

      - name: Upload SARIF
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        with:
          sarif_file: anchore.sarif
```
